decisions.reason: It builds directly on the firm's psychiatric and therapeutic expertise, was given a dedicated page, and the firm has the absorptive capacity to refine it within its existing mental-health services.

The workshop fits the firm's practical therapy and production know-how, but custom furniture is more commercially peripheral to core care services and therefore somewhat more at risk if learning effects are weaker than expected.
Outpatient sociotherapy is very close to the firm's established support offer, so existing knowledge and R&D should make it relatively easy to interpret demand and improve the service.
Senior-living counseling is closely tied to the firm's eldercare activities and network of facilities, and its prominent placement suggests it is strategically important and likely to be retained.

A retail outlet for sheltered-workshop products matches the firm's inclusion and production capabilities, but retailing is less central than care provision and may be dropped sooner if it does not scale well.
